Build an interactive 2D figure from the brief below and the source image.

AUTHORED FIGURE BRIEF:
This figure compares two competing models of enzyme–substrate binding through four sequential diagrams arranged in two panels: panel (a) for the lock-and-key model and panel (b) for the induced fit model. In panel (a), the left diagram shows a green enzyme with a rigid, pre-formed active site cavity labeled 'Active site is proper shape,' with two complementary-shaped purple substrate molecules (labeled 'Substrates') positioned above it ready to fit precisely into the cleft; the right diagram shows the resulting 'Substrate complex formed' with the substrates seated snugly in the geometrically unchanged active site. In panel (b), the left diagram shows the enzyme with a more open and flexible active site labeled 'Active site changes to fit,' indicating a conformational adjustment upon substrate approach; the right diagram shows the 'Substrate complex formed' after the enzyme has reshaped itself to wrap tightly around the substrate. Both models account for substrate specificity — only a structurally compatible molecule can bind the active site — but differ in whether that specificity arises from a rigid pre-formed pocket or from an adaptive conformational change induced by substrate binding. This figure introduces enzyme active-site specificity at the molecular level and sets up the comparison of lock-and-key versus induced-fit mechanisms as competing explanations for how enzymes selectively bind and catalyze reactions with particular substrates.

REQUESTED INTERACTIONS:
- Toggle between the lock-and-key model (left pair) and the induced-fit model (right pair): observe the rigid versus flexible active site as the substrate approaches and binds
- Animate substrate binding: show the substrate docking into the active site for each model, highlighting the conformational change in the induced-fit case but not in the lock-and-key case

SOURCE FILE: OpenStax Chemistry 2e, chapter 12

There is no blueprint: decide the figure type, elements, labels, controls, and any step sequence yourself.

// @FIGURE_CODE_BEGIN // LIBRARY: svgjs var W = 977, H = 428; var draw = SVG().addTo(document.getElementById('container')).size('100%', '100%'); draw.viewbox(0, 0, W, H); var COL = { enzyme:'#e6eebc', enzymeStroke:'#8aa03c', sub:'#cbb8d6', subStroke:'#6e5a78', stem:'#d8a98f', stemStroke:'#8a6a52' }; // ---------- enzyme shape helpers ---------- // x: center, topY: top of enzyme dome, cleft depth variants function enzymePath(x, topY, w, cleftD, cleftW) { var hw = w / 2; var botY = topY + 105; var cw = cleftW / 2; var d = 'M ' + (x - hw) + ' ' + (botY - 12) + ' Q ' + (x - hw - 14) + ' ' + (topY + 40) + ' ' + (x - hw + 22) + ' ' + (topY + 12) + ' Q ' + (x - cw - 26) + ' ' + topY + ' ' + (x - cw) + ' ' + topY + ' L ' + (x - cw) + ' ' + (topY + cleftD) + ' Q ' + x + ' ' + (topY + cleftD + 6) + ' ' + (x + cw) + ' ' + (topY + cleftD) + ' L ' + (x + cw) + ' ' + topY + ' Q ' + (x + cw + 26) + ' ' + topY + ' ' + (x + hw - 22) + ' ' + (topY + 12) + ' Q ' + (x + hw + 14) + ' ' + (topY + 40) + ' ' + (x + hw) + ' ' + (botY - 12) + ' Q ' + (x + hw) + ' ' + (botY + 8) + ' ' + (x + hw - 30) + ' ' + botY + ' Q ' + x + ' ' + (botY + 10) + ' ' + (x - hw + 30) + ' ' + botY + ' Q ' + (x - hw) + ' ' + (botY + 8) + ' ' + (x - hw) + ' ' + (botY - 12) + ' Z'; return d; } function innerPath(x, topY, w, cleftD, cleftW) { return enzymePath(x, topY + 10, w - 16, Math.max(2, cleftD - 8), Math.max(6, cleftW - 12)); } function drawEnzyme(parent, x, topY, w, cleftD, cleftW) { var g = parent.group(); g.path(innerPath(x, topY, w, cleftD, cleftW)).fill('#f2f7da').stroke('none'); g.path(enzymePath(x, topY, w, cleftD, cleftW)).fill(COL.enzyme).stroke({ color: COL.enzymeStroke, width: 3 }); return g; } // ---------- substrate pair ---------- // two purple blobs with small stems, positioned above enzyme center x at baseline y0 function drawSubstrates(parent, x, y0, gap, spread) { var g = parent.group(); function blob(cx, mirror) { var m = mirror ? -1 : 1; var d = 'M ' + cx + ' ' + (y0 + 62) + ' L ' + (cx + m * 14) + ' ' + (y0 + 62) + ' Q ' + (cx + m * 30) + ' ' + (y0 + 56) + ' ' + (cx + m * 30) + ' ' + (y0 + 36) + ' Q ' + (cx + m * 32) + ' ' + (y0 + 10) + ' ' + (cx + m * 10) + ' ' + (y0 + 2) + ' Q ' + (cx - m * 4) + ' ' + (y0 - 4) + ' ' + (cx - m * 4) + ' ' + (y0 + 24) + ' L ' + (cx - m * 4) + ' ' + (y0 + 62) + ' Z'; return d; } var lx = x - spread / 2, rx = x + spread / 2; // stems g.rect(12, 18).center(lx + 5, y0 + 66).fill(COL.stem).stroke({ color: COL.stemStroke, width: 1.5 }); g.rect(12, 18).center(rx - 5, y0 + 66).fill(COL.stem).stroke({ color: COL.stemStroke, width: 1.5 }); g.path(blob(lx + 4, false)).fill(COL.sub).stroke({ color: COL.subStroke, width: 2.5 }); g.path(blob(rx - 4, true)).fill(COL.sub).stroke({ color: COL.subStroke, width: 2.5 }); return g; } function label(g, str, x, y, size, anchor) { return g.text(str).font({ size: size || 19, family: 'sans-serif', anchor: anchor || 'middle' }) .move(x, y).fill('#222').attr({ 'paint-order': 'stroke', stroke: '#fff', 'stroke-width': 3, 'stroke-linejoin': 'round' }); } function leader(g, x1, y1, x2, y2) { g.line(x1, y1, x2, y2).stroke({ color: '#555', width: 1.5 }); } // ---------- panel (a) ---------- var gA = draw.group().attr('id', 'panelA'); // diagram 1: rigid enzyme + substrates above label(gA, 'Substrates', 105, 6, 21); leader(gA, 92, 34, 46, 92); leader(gA, 128, 34, 168, 88); label(gA, 'Active', 110, 72, 18); label(gA, 'site is', 110, 95, 18); label(gA, 'proper', 110, 118, 18); label(gA, 'shape', 110, 141, 18); leader(gA, 96, 165, 96, 246); leader(gA, 128, 165, 128, 246); var subA = drawSubstrates(gA, 108, 60, 0, 130); var enzAopen = drawEnzyme(gA, 108, 236, 172, 34, 62); var enzAclosed = drawEnzyme(gA, 108, 236, 172, 10, 58); enzAclosed.opacity(0); label(gA, 'Enzyme', 108, 358, 20); // diagram 2: complex formed label(gA, 'Substrate', 365, 70, 19); label(gA, 'complex', 365, 93, 19); label(gA, 'formed', 365, 116, 19); drawEnzyme(gA, 365, 236, 172, 34, 62); drawSubstrates(gA, 365, 176, 0, 130); label(gA, 'Enzyme', 365, 358, 20); label(gA, '(a) Lock-and-key model', 240, 396, 21); // ---------- panel (b) ---------- var gB = draw.group().attr('id', 'panelB'); label(gB, 'Substrates', 633, 6, 21); leader(gB, 620, 34, 574, 92); leader(gB, 656, 34, 696, 88); label(gB, 'Active', 640, 72, 18); label(gB, 'site', 640, 95, 18); label(gB, 'changes', 640, 118, 18); label(gB, 'to fit', 640, 141, 18); leader(gB, 616, 168, 606, 246); leader(gB, 664, 168, 674, 246); var subB = drawSubstrates(gB, 636, 60, 0, 130); var enzBopen = drawEnzyme(gB, 636, 236, 172, 20, 96); var enzBclosed = drawEnzyme(gB, 636, 236, 172, 34, 58); enzBclosed.opacity(0); label(gB, 'Enzyme', 636, 358, 20); label(gB, 'Substrate', 887, 70, 19); label(gB, 'complex', 887, 93, 19); label(gB, 'formed', 887, 116, 19); drawEnzyme(gB, 887, 236, 172, 34, 58); drawSubstrates(gB, 887, 176, 0, 130); label(gB, 'Enzyme', 887, 358, 20); label(gB, '(b) Induced fit model', 755, 396, 21); // hover/click teaching enzAopen.on('click', function(){ showPopup('Lock-and-key model','The enzyme\'s active site is rigid and already the correct shape. A substrate binds only if its shape complements the pre-formed pocket exactly — like a key fitting a lock.'); }).css('cursor','pointer') .on('mousemove', function(e){ showTooltip('Rigid, pre-formed active site', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); enzBopen.on('click', function(){ showPopup('Induced fit model','The active site is flexible. As the substrate approaches, the enzyme changes shape to wrap snugly around it — specificity comes from an adaptive conformational change, not a rigid pocket.'); }).css('cursor','pointer') .on('mousemove', function(e){ showTooltip('Flexible active site — reshapes to fit', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip); subA.on('mousemove', function(e){ showTooltip('Substrates (complementary shape)', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip).css('cursor','pointer'); subB.on('mousemove', function(e){ showTooltip('Substrates (induce the fit)', e); }).on('mouseleave', hideTooltip).css('cursor','pointer'); // ---------- interaction state ---------- var model = 'lock'; // 'lock' | 'fit' var animState = 'unbound'; // 'unbound' | 'bound' var animating = false; var narration = document.getElementById('demoNarration'); function refreshPanels() { gA.opacity(model === 'lock' ? 1 : 0.28); gB.opacity(model === 'fit' ? 1 : 0.28); document.getElementById('lockBtn').className = model === 'lock' ? 'active' : ''; document.getElementById('fitBtn').className = model === 'fit' ? 'active' : ''; } function setState(bound) { animState = bound ? 'bound' : 'unbound'; subA.dy(bound && model === 'lock' ? 116 : 0); subB.dy(bound && model === 'fit' ? 116 : 0); enzAclosed.opacity(bound && model === 'lock' ? 1 : 0); enzBclosed.opacity(bound && model === 'fit' ? 1 : 0); if (model === 'lock') subB.dy(0), enzBclosed.opacity(0); if (model === 'fit') subA.dy(0), enzAclosed.opacity(0); } function selectModel(m) { model = m; setState(false); refreshPanels(); narration.textContent = m === 'lock' ? 'Lock-and-key: the active site is already the right shape — rigid and pre-formed. Animate to watch the substrate dock without any shape change.' : 'Induced fit: the active site is open and flexible. Animate to watch the enzyme reshape itself around the substrate as it binds.'; } function selectModelClick(m) { selectModel(m); } function trigger_reset() { if (animating) return; setState(false); narration.textContent = 'Reset. Choose a model and animate the binding again.'; } function trigger_animate() { if (animating) return; if (animState === 'bound') { setState(false); return; } animating = true; var sub = model === 'lock' ? subA : subB; var closed = model === 'lock' ? enzAclosed : enzBclosed; var open = model === 'lock' ? enzAopen : enzBopen; var t0 = performance.now(), dur = 1600, target = 116; narration.textContent = model === 'lock' ? 'Substrate descending… the rigid pocket needs no adjustment.' : 'Substrate approaching… watch the active site mold itself around it.'; function step(now) { var t = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / dur); var e = t < 0.5 ? 2 * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 2) / 2; sub.dy(target * e); if (model === 'fit') { closed.opacity(e); open.opacity(1); } // crossfade = conformational change if (t < 1) requestAnimationFrame(step); else { animating = false; setState(true); narration.textContent = model === 'lock' ? 'Bound! The substrate complex formed with no change to the enzyme — pure geometric complementarity.' : 'Bound! The enzyme changed shape to wrap around the substrate — specificity through induced fit. Click Animate again to release.'; } } requestAnimationFrame(step); } selectModel('lock'); window.__markRendered(); // @FIGURE_CODE_END
